description: Repeat a step's work until a condition is met -- Airflow 3.4's task-loop (@task_group.loop(max_iterations=, until=)).

outputs.description: The body callable's return value from the iteration that stopped the loop (or the last iteration, for a fixed-count loop).

callable_path.label: Callable Path
callable_path.description: 'module.path:function_name'. The loop body -- called once per iteration with the same TaskFlow-style inputs/args/kwargs binding as python_callable_asset.

max_iterations.label: Max Iterations
max_iterations.description: Maximum number of times the body runs. Required, same as Airflow's own .loop(max_iterations=...).

until_callable_path.label: Until Callable Path
until_callable_path.description: 'module.path:function_name'. Called as until_fn(loop=LoopState(...)) after every iteration. Must return bool or (stop: bool, reason). Omit for a fixed-count loop (runs max_iterations times, always succeeds).

args.label: Args
args.description: Static positional arguments passed to the body callable on every iteration.

kwargs.label: Kwargs
kwargs.description: Static keyword arguments passed to the body callable on every iteration.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: {name: upstream_asset_key}. Each entry's value is loaded via the IO manager (once, before the loop starts) and bound to a parameter of that name if the body callable's signature declares one (TaskFlow-style) -- same shape as python_callable_asset's `inputs`.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Fail this step if the WHOLE loop (every iteration, not just one) hasn't finished after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying call may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.
